summary: Melar Acquisition Corp. I (a SPAC) filed an 8-K regarding entry into an intercreditor agreement on May 8, 2026. The agreement governs the rights, priorities, and obligations between Melar Lender and YA Lender with respect to indebtedness of Everli Global Inc. and related parties under promissory notes. The two lenders agreed that the indebtedness ranks pari passu, sharing equally and ratably in payments. This is a financing arrangement between lenders, not a business combination or special situation event for the registrant. The filing does not announce a merger, acquisition, or other special situation.
